name: wanding
description: Wanding quotation MCP suite: bundled wanding-quotation-mcp + 3 slash commands + 2 business knowledge skills + 1 quotation assistant agent + 2 security hooks.

python_executable.title: Python executable path
python_executable.description: Absolute path to your python interpreter. Leave blank to auto-pick (win32=python, others=python3).

aol_token.title: Accurate AOL Access Token (for inventory queries)
aol_token.description: Accurate Online API access token used for live inventory queries against the AOL backend. Stored in your system keychain (sensitive).

aol_signature_secret.title: Accurate signature secret
aol_signature_secret.description: HMAC signing secret for the Accurate API. Stored in your system keychain (sensitive).

approved_paths.title: Whitelisted directories (semicolon-separated)
approved_paths.description: Paths where fill_quotation_sheet / parse_excel_smart can read/write. Default: ~/Documents/wanding/
